info.title: Carepoint HMS
info.description:
APIs for managing the Carepoint Hospital Management System including authentication, RBAC, fine-grained permissions, user management, facility / multi-branch scoping, patient registration, appointments, visits, queue routing, clinical workflows (triage, vitals, consultation, diagnosis), laboratory (catalog, orders, results), pharmacy (drug catalog, prescriptions, dispensing, inventory, stock movements), inpatient admission with ward/bed assignment and bed-day billing, discharge, billing/invoice/payment (charge-to-cash), notifications, compliance, and reporting.

Authentication flow
-------------------
This application uses **JWT bearer authentication**.

When 2FA is enabled on a user account, login is a 2-step flow:

1. ``POST /api/v1/auth/login``
2. If 2FA is required, the response carries ``two_factor_required=true``.
   Call ``POST /api/v1/auth/two-factor/verify`` (or
   ``POST /api/v1/auth/otp/verify``) to obtain final tokens.
3. The custom Swagger UI captures the ``access_token`` automatically.
4. Secured endpoints are then called with:

   `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`

Public auth endpoints (no bearer required):
- ``POST /api/v1/auth/login``
- ``POST /api/v1/auth/refresh``
- ``POST /api/v1/auth/forgot-password``
- ``POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password``
- ``POST /api/v1/auth/otp/verify``
- ``POST /api/v1/auth/otp/resend``
- ``POST /api/v1/auth/two-factor/verify``
- ``POST /api/v1/auth/email-verification/request``
- ``POST /api/v1/auth/email-verification/confirm``
- ``POST /api/v1/auth/phone-verification/request``
- ``POST /api/v1/auth/phone-verification/confirm``

receives the plaintext via the chosen channel.

patient portal. If the patient has no linked :class:`User` yet, one
is auto-created and assigned the ``PATIENT`` role.

Re-dispatch the active OTP. A fresh code is generated and the
expiry window is reset; previous codes are invalidated.

AdmissionCreateSchema.title: AdmissionCreateSchema
AdmissionCreateSchema.description:
Schema used to create an admission row.

Notes
-----
- ``visit_id`` is optional but strongly recommended; it ties the inpatient
  stay to its outpatient encounter for billing roll-up.
- ``ward_id`` and ``bed_id`` may be supplied at admit time. When
  ``bed_id`` is supplied, it must belong to ``ward_id``.
- ``capture_first_bed_day_charge`` defaults to True so the first night's
  bed-day fee is captured into the visit's open billing immediately.

visit_id.title: Visit Id
visit_id.description: The ER / OPD visit being converted.

bed_id.title: Bed Id
bed_id.description: If omitted, the admission service auto-picks the first AVAILABLE bed.

route_to_service_delivery_point_id.title: Route To Service Delivery Point Id
route_to_service_delivery_point_id.description: If supplied, route the visit to this SDP (typically the ward / inpatient SDP) so the visit-flow timeline reflects the move.

AdmissionFromVisitConvertSchema.title: AdmissionFromVisitConvertSchema
AdmissionFromVisitConvertSchema.description:
Convert an in-progress ER / OPD visit into an inpatient admission in
one call. Reuses the same visit (so the OPD bill rolls forward into
the inpatient bill) and books a bed.

The service marks the old bed AVAILABLE and the new bed OCCUPIED.

same call. This is the supported path for direct-admission scenarios
such as ER → ward, scheduled inpatient procedures, and obstetric
admissions.
